rules.name: Deduction truth
rules.rule: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.

rules.name: Eligibility first
rules.rule: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.

rules.name: No timeline promises
rules.rule: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.

rules.name: Confirmed allotment
rules.rule: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.

forbidden_actions: Initiating a refund without an eligibility result.
Quoting a deduction or refund amount the tool did not return.
Promising a faster refund than the tool states.

rules.name: Price truth
rules.rule: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.

rules.name: Possession claims
rules.rule: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.

rules.name: RERA disclosure
rules.rule: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.

rules.name: No investment advice
rules.rule: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

forbidden_actions: Quoting a price or possession date no tool returned.
Predicting price appreciation or advising on investment merit.
Booking a visit to a project with no matching inventory.

check_inventory.purpose: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

check_refund_eligibility.purpose: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

initiate_refund.purpose: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

lookup_booking.purpose: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

lookup_lead.purpose: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

schedule_site_visit.purpose: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

booking_amount.purpose: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
booking_amount.business_context: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

terminal_success_conditions: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.
Caller told why the booking is not refundable and on what terms.
escalation_conditions: Caller disputes the deduction the policy applies.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

site_visit_scheduling.purpose: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.
site_visit_scheduling.business_context: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

terminal_success_conditions: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.
Caller told no matching unit exists and given what does.
escalation_conditions: Caller alleges a commitment a previous executive made that the record does not show.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
